verses.text:
Out of the depths

I cry to You, O LORD!

O Lord, hear my voice;

let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities,

then who, O Lord, could stand?

But with You there is forgiveness,

so that You may be feared.

I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait,

and in His word I put my hope.

My soul waits for the Lord

more than watchmen wait for the morning—

more than watchmen wait for the morning.

And He will redeem Israel

from all iniquity.

text: Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD! O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy. If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand? But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared. I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope. My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning. O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance. And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
